name: Deniz Yilmaz
bio:
Deniz Yilmaz's journey into motorsport began in his teens, fueled by a passion for engineering and a fascination with Formula 1. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering from Istanbul Technical University before diving headfirst into the racing world. His early career involved stints with smaller racing outfits, where he quickly gained experience in vehicle dynamics and race strategy. Recognizing his knack for leadership, Deniz transitioned into team management, showcasing a remarkable ability to motivate teams and optimize performance. His approach to his role centers around data-driven decision-making and a collaborative environment, fostering innovation and excellence within RFK Racing. 

What sets Deniz apart is his commitment to pushing boundaries. He's not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and embraces new technologies to gain a competitive edge. He is known for his ability to quickly adapt to changing track conditions and make split-second decisions that often result in crucial gains for his team. His long-term vision is to bring RFK Racing to the forefront of motorsport and foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

Deniz brings a unique combination of technical understanding and leadership ability to the role of team principal. His focus on data-driven strategies and collaborative environment will hopefully lead RFK Racing to success.
